[LDET.2.4.10] If the event trace is identical, the output is identical. If
the event trace differs by even one re-ordered event, the
guarantee does not apply — the output may legitimately change.
Recording captures all of the above; replay reproduces all of
the above; simulated tests supply all of the above from the
harness.

tla.name: ldet_2_4_10__same_trace
tla.note: Two engine copies consume one input trace -- every sequence of length at most 4 over assert A, assert B, pump -- and keep identical working memory, agenda and fired sequence at every state, firing in the LDET.5.1 order with the timetag (latest assertion position, then lexicographic). No key is hard-coded: it is a function of the match and the trace, and with the lexicographic tiebreak disabled TLC fails on <<A, A, B, P>>, where one assertion completes two matches with one key (the measured TEETH). partial for scope, not vacuity: asserts and pumps only, two rules, no retraction, no RHS effect, no NOT pattern, no clock, while the clause covers the whole engine over the whole event trace.
